text: {"features":[{"name":"Relevant software engineering experience","description":"The letter shows how much hands-on production software experience the applicant has across testing, maintenance, launch, and ongoing ownership of services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter only minimally clears the role's experience bar and gives limited evidence of repeated production ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows some experience beyond the minimum, but the scope or breadth of production work remains modest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid multi-year experience across testing, maintaining, and launching several production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows extensive production experience with repeated launches and ongoing responsibility for systems in service."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows especially deep production experience with sustained ownership of multiple live systems and a strong sense of reliability-minded stewardship."}]},{"name":"Formal academic preparation","description":"The letter conveys the strength of the applicant's formal academic preparation relative to the role's preferred education level.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant bachelor's degree, which meets the minimum but does not add preferred academic strength."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter presents a bachelor's degree and suggests stronger-than-basic formal technical grounding, but no advanced degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant master's degree, matching the preferred academic level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant doctorate, exceeding the preferred academic level."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant advanced degree and explicitly connects that training to role-relevant systems, security, or AI work."}]},{"name":"Go engineering depth","description":"The letter shows how convincingly the applicant demonstrates substantive experience building production systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter names Go as a language used but gives no concrete evidence of what the applicant builds in it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter identifies Go as a main language and ties it to general product work, but not to specific back-end or security systems."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives at least one clear example of using Go for production services or infrastructure."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong Go ownership in back-end systems that support automation, control, or reliability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter uses concrete examples to present Go as a core strength for designing and operating robust back-end systems directly relevant to this role."}]},{"name":"Python engineering depth","description":"The letter shows how much real, production-quality Python work the applicant has done in services, tooling, or agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention Python at all or mentions it only in passing."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Python for scripts or general automation but gives limited evidence of depth or production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes regular Python use for services, analysis, tooling, or prototypes with some concrete detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong Python ownership in production services, automation layers, or internal tools that others rely on."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents Python as deep, production-grade expertise central to maintainable tooling, services, or agent behavior."}]},{"name":"Data structures fluency","description":"The letter provides evidence of practical skill choosing and applying data structures or algorithms to solve engineering problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter offers no meaningful evidence of algorithmic thinking beyond generic technical competence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter claims comfort with data structures or algorithms but gives little concrete proof."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives one clear example of using a better data structure or algorithm to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong practical algorithmic reasoning through clear examples such as indexes, graph work, matching, caches, or streaming computation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents algorithmic thinking as a standout strength with especially strong or repeated examples that clearly shaped system design."}]},{"name":"Applied AI experience","description":"The letter shows how much hands-on experience the applicant has shipping AI or LLM-based capabilities in real systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of working with AI or LLM-based systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions AI interest or exposure but not concrete shipped work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes building or shipping AI or LLM-based features with some awareness of reliability concerns."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial applied AI experience in production together with evaluation, failure-mode handling, or trustworthiness work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates deep applied AI work directly relevant to the role, emphasizing reliable deployment, evaluation, and operational guardrails."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"The letter shows experience designing agent-based systems with explicit architecture, control, or safety boundaries.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of designing agentic systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions agents or autonomy in passing without enough architectural detail to judge depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes building an agent-based system with a basic division between agents and supporting services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly explains an agentic architecture, such as Python agents operating within Go-enforced constraints or audited boundaries."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents agent design as a major strength, showing deliberate thinking about autonomy, contracts, permissions, logging, or safety limits."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability handling automation","description":"The letter shows experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, deduplication, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of automating vulnerability handling or triage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions security automation generally but not clear ownership of a vulnerability workflow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes automating part of vulnerability report intake or triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows concrete ownership of a vulnerability pipeline that classifies, routes, deduplicates, or otherwise reduces manual work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates strong end-to-end ownership of vulnerability handling automation with clear workflow design and explicit operational impact."}]},{"name":"Security assessment ability","description":"The letter shows how much concrete experience the applicant has performing security assessments of systems, designs, or code.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no concrete evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions security reviews or assessments vaguely, without showing what was actually done."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes concrete assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or validating fixes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial assessment experience across designs or services, with an attacker-oriented approach or clear follow-through."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates especially strong security assessment credibility through repeated hands-on assessments plus rigorous validation, leadership, or comparable proof."}]},{"name":"Security automation insight","description":"The letter demonstrates how thoughtfully the applicant understands the value of automating security work at scale.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives little sign of understanding why security automation matters beyond wanting a security role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter expresses general interest in security tooling but mostly at the slogan level."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter articulates a clear reason for automating security work, such as reducing manual toil or scaling scarce expertise."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows a thoughtful systems view of secure-by-default development, workflow design, or the leverage of automation in a large organization."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a sharp, memorable philosophy of security automation that connects developer behavior, operational constraints, and scalable systems."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement orientation","description":"The letter shows whether the applicant thinks about security tooling as something that should help developers adopt secure practices in their normal workflow.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows little awareness of developer workflows or of security tooling as a service to other engineers."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions helping teams in broad terms but does not show concrete empathy for how developers actually work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter acknowledges that security tooling should fit developer workflows or reduce friction."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly frames security work as enabling developers through defaults, usable tools, or close partnership rather than policing."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes developer empathy a core theme, showing nuanced understanding that adoption depends on fitting real engineering behavior and incentives."}]},{"name":"Platform leverage orientation","description":"The letter shows how strongly the applicant is motivated by building foundational systems whose benefits spread across many teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter focuses narrowly on tasks or personal interest and shows little sense of organization-wide leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter hints at broad impact but does not clearly frame the work as foundational or platform-like."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows appreciation for building tools that help other teams or improve shared workflows."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly values foundational systems whose improvements are inherited across many teams or products."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter centers its motivation and examples on multiplying others' effectiveness through shared infrastructure at large scale."}]},{"name":"Role targeting","description":"The letter shows how specifically it is tailored to this Google Information Security Engineering role rather than to a generic software position.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter could plausibly be sent to a generic software role with minimal change."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Google or security in broad terms but engages only lightly with the posted role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter connects to at least one specific responsibility or qualification from the posting."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is clearly tailored to several posted responsibilities, such as agentic tooling, vulnerability triage, Go back ends, or developer support."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter feels precisely written for this Google Information Security Engineering role, integrating multiple posted responsibilities and constraints naturally rather than as a checklist."}]},{"name":"Technical specificity","description":"The letter shows how concretely it describes what the applicant built, changed, or owned.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter relies mostly on broad claims and abstractions."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter includes a few specific technologies or tasks, but many claims remain unsupported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives several concrete technical examples that make major claims believable."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter anchors most major claims in specific systems, workflows, or implementation details."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter uses consistently precise, role-relevant technical examples that let the reader picture what was actually built or changed."}]},{"name":"Impact evidence","description":"The letter shows how clearly it explains the results or significance of the applicant's past work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter describes responsibilities without stating outcomes or significance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter implies value but gives little indication of what improved or why it mattered."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter provides some outcome or benefit, though the scale or importance remains only partly clear."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly states how past work reduced toil, improved performance, increased reliability, or changed team behavior."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter repeatedly ties work to substantial, concrete outcomes and makes the operational value unmistakable."}]},{"name":"Engineering initiative beyond core job","description":"The letter shows self-directed technical initiative outside routine assigned work, such as open-source maintainership or substantial personal projects.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter offers no evidence of self-directed technical initiative outside routine assigned work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions limited side activity, occasional small fixes, or a minor personal build with modest ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows a consistent habit of personal builds or upstream contributions that demonstrate initiative."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates substantial self-directed work such as maintaining a project, regular open-source contributions, or building meaningful systems independently."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows exceptional initiative through sustained maintainership of widely used tools or ambitious personal infrastructure projects built to a high standard."}]},{"name":"Offensive security engagement","description":"The letter shows external evidence of hands-on attacker-oriented security practice beyond ordinary development work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no signal of hands-on attacker-oriented practice beyond ordinary development work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows only introductory security signaling, such as a basic certification or casual mention of interest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows meaningful hands-on engagement through recurring capture-the-flag participation or a practical certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong attacker-oriented practice through top competition results, OSCP-level validation, or similarly demanding evidence."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows multiple strong external signals of offensive security capability and sustained commitment to keeping that perspective sharp."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"The letter shows the overall quality of written execution, including clarity, grammar, spelling, and professional finish.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent spelling, grammar, or wording errors noticeably distract from the application."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Several errors or awkward constructions interrupt the flow and weaken professionalism."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter is readable and generally professional, but it has occasional errors or clunky phrasing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter uses clear, fluent prose with only minor slips that do not distract."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is highly polished, clear, professional, and essentially error-free."}]}]}
